name: Ottilde
desc:
Ottilde is a Chrysid NPC. She is a worker of [The Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union).

Ottilde has known nothing but the Union since she was born.

She wears the Ignition Welder Outfit and Smith's Goggles.
additional_info:
-   Her aspect was once bugged, being both a Gremor and Chrysid at the same time.
-   Ottilde's hair ID is https://www.roblox.com/catalog/11844088437/Curly-Hippie-Mullet-White
